decisions.reason: Copper-coated glass packaging substrates draw directly on the firm's long glass processing, polishing and patterning know-how, so it can readily learn from early customer results and refine the line in a growing glass-substrate packaging market that fits its strategic direction.

Laser-based through-glass via structuring is a newly launched flagship that complements its glass substrates and its investment in newer processing technologies, and its existing glass expertise lets it absorb and develop this technology further.
